description: This file defines the `FunctionExpression` interface, which represents a function expression used in a pipeline within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes constants and a method signature for resolving expressions involving functions like 'fn:substring-before' or 'fn:default'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Executes the function expression by processing the given expression string with the provided resolved input value and expression resolver, returning a PipelineElement.
